cohortsHint: Each row is the clients who signed that month; each column is months since. Most loss in the first three months means onboarding is where to look.
grrHint: The same without growth — what was kept.
hint: Where recurring revenue comes from, where it goes, and whether the clients who sign stay.
movementHint: Above the line it came in, below it went out.
nrrHint: Last year's clients pay this share of what they did, growth included. Above 100% grows without new sales.
